publicReleaseNotes: Eight one-minute monitors now fit a Workers Free account. A Worker check writes about 6 D1 rows instead of 8, and the Cron that runs each minute does less work. Local measurements showed about 71,300 rows written per day with all eight monitors healthy, and 85,700 with one monitor failing all day and old snapshots expiring. Migration 0099 adds a column for claiming checks and rewrites no rows. Uptime can now read failure snapshots stored together for one check. The monitor docs explain how to use monitor- or tag-scoped API keys with the read API. Product screenshot available from Uptime 0.4.0 at 1440 pixels (.github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png). — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-27
